resources.string: Songlass cannot verify this file right now. Refresh the library and check music access, then try again. No lyrics have been attached.
The song or saved text changed. Review the selection again before linking it.
The saved lyrics could not be read or updated. Existing texts have been kept. Try again.

These texts have no verified link to an available song. Choose a text, check its preview and link it to the song currently open. Older imports are kept here because their original file cannot be identified safely.
No imports need a new link.
This document cannot be linked because its format is damaged or unsupported. It remains stored and included in manual backups. You can import a corrected LRC, TTML or TXT file.
Check that these words belong to this song. Linking changes the saved association; it does not edit the audio file.
This song already has an import. Confirming replaces that import with the text below. Cancel keeps both texts as they are.
Kept without a link to a file. Open a song’s lyrics and choose Recover imports to link them.
Check these words and their destination before importing. The audio file is not edited.

This song is not currently verified. Retry refreshes the library; when the song is available, review this import again. If the original song is gone, cancel and choose the intended song. Nothing is imported to the song currently playing.
This document could not be read or its text is unsupported. Check access to the selected file, retry, or choose another LRC, TTML or TXT file. Existing lyrics are unchanged.

This import could not be started because the song has not been verified. Close this window, wait for the library to load or refresh it and check music access, then open the intended song and choose Import lyrics again. No document has been imported.
